title: Influencers fear having their content branded as AI slop
excerpt: Social apps are flagging influencer content as AI-generated, and it's making some creators feel grouped in with synthetic slop.

Ashton McGrady was horrified to discover that TikTok had slapped an "AI-generated" label on a post she'd made for Disability Pride Month.

The creator had spent hours making a collage of images, stickers, and advice.

"It was really jarring to me, because that's not something that I personally align with, and neither does my audience," McGrady told Business Insider. "The whole point of being a creator is to create myself." The post later had its AI note removed without explanation.

McGrady's upload was one of the billions that TikTok says it has flagged using a mix of human labeling and automated tools. McGrady said she had a similar experience with a different post on Meta-owned Instagram, too.

Platforms like TikTok and Instagram say AI labeling offers more transparency to viewers, but the inexact processes have led to misclassifications, seven creators say. Some platforms acknowledge they're not always accurate at spotting AI, using phrases like Meta's "likely created or modified with AI" to hedge. For creators, even the suggestion that they've published AI content can feel damaging to their reputations.

Gregory Littley, who frequently posts photography to his Instagram, said several of his posts — which include scans of physical Polaroids — say that the "content in this post may have been modified with AI."

"I cringe when I see that label," Littley said. "I cringe even more when I know it's not true."

These labels could have real consequences for creators in a time of intense AI backlash. It's particularly relevant in the $12 billion US influencer marketing industry, where authenticity and human connection are paramount. An AI hiccup can turn an audience against an influencer. YouTuber Hank Green, for example, recently apologized after coming under fire for using ChatGPT to help research a script.

"It's literally the Scarlet Letter," creator Lissette Calveiro said about AI labels and accusations of producing AI-assisted work. Some brands have begun adding stipulations in campaign briefs that creators can't use generative AI.

In recent weeks, AI has been thrust into the center of the creator conversation. Substack's CEO took a shot at AI-generated LinkedIn posts while debuting a new AI detection partnership. Days later, LinkedIn announced a button to flag suspected "AI slop." YouTube has been pulling down channels that host "low-quality" AI content, and Snapchat has made videos wholly generated by AI ineligible for recommendation in its short-form video feed, Spotlight.

Both openly using AI and promoting AI companies are increasingly seen as risky in creator economy circles. The concern is warranted. Influencers who attended a recent luxury retreat hosted by OpenAI faced immediate online backlash.

"There's a PR issue with AI as it relates to taking people's jobs and environmental concerns around data centers," said Eric Bogard, CEO of the talent firm UnderCurrent Management. "Creators are hesitant to promote AI companies as a result."

At the same time, there's no real path of purity as an influencer traversing content creation in 2026. Nearly every platform automatically uses or pushes AI tools, from Adobe Photoshop to TikTok's CapCut. In many ways, AI tools have helped creators balance the workload of managing their social media accounts and brand deals, as well as brainstorming.

Companies like OpenAI want creators to be more open about their use of AI.

Charles Porch, who OpenAI poached from Meta this year to lead creative partnerships, recently told Business Insider that part of his job is getting creators to "come out of the closet" about using AI.

"Whether creators choose to share how they use AI publicly is entirely up to them," an OpenAI spokesperson said.

AI's 'PR issue'

AI is infiltrating many aspects of modern life — and content creation is no exception.

A May survey of 16,000 creators conducted by Adobe, in partnership with The Harris Poll, found that 75% of creators who had used or tried creative AI described it as "integrated or essential to how they work."

Not all creators want to admit that publicly, though, lest they wear the AI "Scarlet Letter" on their chest.

YouTube creator Billy Yue, who goes by 8illy, isn't shying away from AI. He even made a promotional video for Anthropic's Claude in November. Still, the creator, who regularly features hand-drawn animation in his videos, added a disclosure at the end of his most recent YouTube upload that "no AI was used" in the production. He wanted fans to know that he'd drawn 1,800 illustrations for the project.

Broader public opinion is shifting, and creators feel it.

The influencer marketing agency Billion Dollar Boy found that the share of consumers who viewed generative AI as a "negative disruptor" increased from 18% in 2023 to 32% in 2025. Those who saw it as a "positive disruptor" declined from 34% to 31%. The firm surveyed 4,000 consumers ages 16 or older in the UK and the US.

"Part of this backlash is every platform is filled with slop," said Max Spero, CEO of AI detection startup Pangram. "It feels like the algorithms are shoving it in your face. It feels like it's harder and harder to find things made with craft by real people." Pangram recently partnered with Substack on an integration that detects whether — and how much — AI was used in writing newsletters and comments.

Concerns about "AI slop" have become a focus on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, which all have automated AI detection tools that help identify content that is either entirely AI-generated or substantially edited with AI.

Lawmakers have also gotten in the mix. The European Union and New York state recently developed laws requiring brands to inform viewers when AI-generated characters appear in ads.

AI labels aren't foolproof

As platforms have rushed to ramp up their AI labeling, creators like McGrady say they have become the victims of false positives.

Lindsey Lee Lugrin, a content creator and model, recently posted some paintings she had made by hand. However, her Instagram posts included a label that said they were "likely created or modified with AI."

In some instances, using popular editing tools like Canva or Adobe's Lightroom resulted in content on Instagram, Threads, and TikTok being flagged as potentially AI-generated.

While third-party platforms like Pangram can assist with AI identification, none are completely accurate. (Substack added options in its AI detection feature for creators to dispute a Pangram assessment, explain how and why they used AI, and even disable the tool altogether.)

Slip-ups can be a risk for both creators and brands.

McGrady said that if a post made in partnership with a brand was flagged as AI, it could "harm your relationship with the brand."

Advertisers are well aware of the public backlash an AI-heavy ad can bring.

Brands are taking proactive action to prevent this. Five creators and talent managers said there had been an increase in clauses in partnership briefs and contracts that explicitly state that creators cannot use AI in parts of the content process — particularly in scriptwriting, captions, and visual edits.

"If you're a brand, you obviously don't want to see an influencer you hire have a 100% negative comment section," said Jack Appleby, a relatively AI-positive creator and social media strategist. "If you're not an AI brand, you probably avoid AI right now, just because there's no reason to risk it."

There is no escaping the AI era

Despite the blowback, AI pervades many aspects of content creation.

Photo and video editing apps use it, whether loudly or under the hood. If you use Instagram's fancy font tools when making a Story post, it will trigger a tag that says the text has been "restyled with AI."

"It's really difficult to have a fully AI-free experience right now, no matter what line of work you're in," Calveiro said. "I think a lot more people are using it than they want to admit."

There are real benefits to some tools, too.

"I very frequently tell my audience that there are ethical and moral reasons to use AI. When I do, it's from an accessibility perspective," McGrady said. "But I am a person who proudly says that I do not use generative AI."

The backlash against creators' use of AI may ease in the coming months as AI-powered creative tools become ubiquitous. Labeling efforts could shift toward flagging only fully AI-generated posts.

More transparency about how AI is used could reduce headaches for creators and platforms alike, making room for them to explore how the tech can expand their creativity.

"I'm very honest about how I use AI," Appleby said. "I don't really run from it. If a piece of content entertains or educates or provides value to somebody, for the most part, they shouldn't really care."

sentences.zh: 例如，YouTube 用户汉克·格林 (Hank Green) 最近因使用 ChatGPT 帮助研究脚本而受到批评，并为此道歉。

blocks.html_en: "It's literally the Scarlet Letter," creator Lissette Calveiro said about AI labels and accusations of producing AI-assisted work. Some brands have begun adding stipulations in campaign briefs that creators can't use generative AI.

sentences.en: "It's literally the Scarlet Letter," creator Lissette Calveiro said about AI labels and accusations of producing AI-assisted work.
sentences.zh: “这实际上是红字，”创作者 Lissette Calveiro 在谈到人工智能标签和对制作人工智能辅助作品的指控时说道。

sentences.en: Some brands have begun adding stipulations in campaign briefs that creators can't use generative AI.
sentences.zh: 一些品牌已经开始在活动简报中添加创作者不能使用生成人工智能的规定。

blocks.html_en: In recent weeks, AI has been thrust into the center of the creator conversation. Substack's CEO took a shot at AI-generated LinkedIn posts while debuting a new AI detection partnership. Days later, LinkedIn announced a button to flag suspected "AI slop." YouTube has been pulling down channels that host "low-quality" AI content, and Snapchat has made videos wholly generated by AI ineligible for recommendation in its short-form video feed, Spotlight.

sentences.en: In recent weeks, AI has been thrust into the center of the creator conversation.
sentences.zh: 最近几周，人工智能已成为创作者对话的中心。

sentences.en: Substack's CEO took a shot at AI-generated LinkedIn posts while debuting a new AI detection partnership.
sentences.zh: Substack 的首席执行官在推出新的人工智能检测合作伙伴关系时，对人工智能生成的 LinkedIn 帖子进行了尝试。

sentences.en: Days later, LinkedIn announced a button to flag suspected "AI slop."
sentences.zh: 几天后，LinkedIn 宣布推出一个按钮来标记可疑的“AI 污点”。

sentences.en: YouTube has been pulling down channels that host "low-quality" AI content, and Snapchat has made videos wholly generated by AI ineligible for recommendation in its short-form video feed, Spotlight.
sentences.zh: YouTube 一直在撤下托管“低质量”人工智能内容的频道，Snapchat 已将完全由人工智能生成的视频设为不符合在其短视频源 Spotlight 中推荐的资格。

blocks.html_en: Both openly using AI and promoting AI companies are increasingly seen as risky in creator economy circles. The concern is warranted. Influencers who attended a recent luxury retreat hosted by OpenAI faced immediate online backlash.

sentences.en: Both openly using AI and promoting AI companies are increasingly seen as risky in creator economy circles.
sentences.zh: 在创作者经济圈中，公开使用人工智能和推广人工智能公司都越来越被视为风险。

sentences.en: The concern is warranted.
sentences.zh: 这种担忧是有道理的。

sentences.en: Influencers who attended a recent luxury retreat hosted by OpenAI faced immediate online backlash.
sentences.zh: 参加最近由 OpenAI 主办的豪华静修会的影响者立即遭到网上强烈反对。

sentences.en: Several of Gregory Littley's Instagram posts with scans of physical Polaroids or photobooth strips have been labeled by Meta.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里·利特利 (Gregory Littley) 的几条带有实物宝丽来照片或照相亭扫描条的 Instagram 帖子已被 Meta 标记。

sentences.en: Screenshot/Instagram/BI
sentences.zh: 截图/Instagram/BI

blocks.html_en: "There's a PR issue with AI as it relates to taking people's jobs and environmental concerns around data centers," said Eric Bogard, CEO of the talent firm UnderCurrent Management. "Creators are hesitant to promote AI companies as a result."

sentences.en: "There's a PR issue with AI as it relates to taking people's jobs and environmental concerns around data centers," said Eric Bogard, CEO of the talent firm UnderCurrent Management.
sentences.zh: 人才公司 UnderCurrent Management 的首席执行官埃里克·博加德 (Eric Bogard) 表示：“人工智能存在公关问题，因为它涉及到数据中心周围的人们的工作和环境问题。”

sentences.en: "Creators are hesitant to promote AI companies as a result."
sentences.zh: “因此，创作者对于推广人工智能公司犹豫不决。”

blocks.html_en: At the same time, there's no real path of purity as an influencer traversing content creation in 2026. Nearly every platform automatically uses or pushes AI tools, from Adobe Photoshop to TikTok's CapCut. In many ways, AI tools have helped creators balance the workload of managing their social media accounts and brand deals, as well as brainstorming.

sentences.en: At the same time, there's no real path of purity as an influencer traversing content creation in 2026.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，2026 年，作为一个有影响力的人，在内容创作方面并没有真正的纯粹之路。

sentences.en: Nearly every platform automatically uses or pushes AI tools, from Adobe Photoshop to TikTok's CapCut.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个平台都会自动使用或推送人工智能工具，从 Adob​​e Photoshop 到 TikTok 的 CapCut。

sentences.en: In many ways, AI tools have helped creators balance the workload of managing their social media accounts and brand deals, as well as brainstorming.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，人工智能工具帮助创作者平衡管理社交媒体帐户和品牌交易以及集思广益的工作量。

blocks.html_en: Companies like OpenAI want creators to be more open about their use of AI.

sentences.en: Companies like OpenAI want creators to be more open about their use of AI.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 等公司希望创作者对人工智能的使用更加开放。

blocks.html_en: Charles Porch, who OpenAI poached from Meta this year to lead creative partnerships, recently told Business Insider that part of his job is getting creators to "come out of the closet" about using AI.

sentences.en: Charles Porch, who OpenAI poached from Meta this year to lead creative partnerships, recently told Business Insider that part of his job is getting creators to "come out of the closet" about using AI.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 今年从 Meta 挖来的查尔斯·波奇 (Charles Porch) 负责领导创意合作伙伴关系，他最近告诉 Business Insider，他的部分工作是让创作者“公开”使用人工智能。

blocks.html_en: "Whether creators choose to share how they use AI publicly is entirely up to them," an OpenAI spokesperson said.

sentences.en: "Whether creators choose to share how they use AI publicly is entirely up to them," an OpenAI spokesperson said.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 发言人表示：“创作者是否选择公开分享他们如何使用人工智能完全取决于他们自己。”

blocks.html_en: AI's 'PR issue'

sentences.en: AI's 'PR issue'
sentences.zh: 人工智能的“公关问题”

blocks.html_en: AI is infiltrating many aspects of modern life — and content creation is no exception.

sentences.en: AI is infiltrating many aspects of modern life — and content creation is no exception.
sentences.zh: 人工智能正在渗透现代生活的许多方面——内容创作也不例外。

blocks.html_en: A May survey of 16,000 creators conducted by Adobe, in partnership with The Harris Poll, found that 75% of creators who had used or tried creative AI described it as "integrated or essential to how they work."

sentences.en: A May survey of 16,000 creators conducted by Adobe, in partnership with The Harris Poll, found that 75% of creators who had used or tried creative AI described it as "integrated or essential to how they work."
sentences.zh: Adobe 与 Harris Poll 合作对 16,000 名创作者进行了 5 月份的一项调查，结果发现，在使用或尝试过创意 AI 的创作者中，75% 的人将其描述为“对于他们的工作方式而言，AI 是集成的或必不可少的”。

blocks.html_en: Not all creators want to admit that publicly, though, lest they wear the AI "Scarlet Letter" on their chest.

sentences.en: Not all creators want to admit that publicly, though, lest they wear the AI "Scarlet Letter" on their chest.
sentences.zh: 不过，并非所有创作者都愿意公开承认这一点，以免他们将人工智能“红字”戴在胸前。

blocks.html_en: YouTube creator Billy Yue, who goes by 8illy, isn't shying away from AI. He even made a promotional video for Anthropic's Claude in November. Still, the creator, who regularly features hand-drawn animation in his videos, added a disclosure at the end of his most recent YouTube upload that "no AI was used" in the production. He wanted fans to know that he'd drawn 1,800 illustrations for the project.

sentences.en: YouTube creator Billy Yue, who goes by 8illy, isn't shying away from AI.
sentences.zh: YouTube 创作者 Bil​​ly Yue（又名 8illy）并没有回避人工智能。

sentences.en: He even made a promotional video for Anthropic's Claude in November.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在11月份为Anthropic的Claude制作了宣传视频。

sentences.en: Still, the creator, who regularly features hand-drawn animation in his videos, added a disclosure at the end of his most recent YouTube upload that "no AI was used" in the production.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这位经常在视频中加入手绘动画的创作者，在他最近上传的 YouTube 视频末尾补充道，制作中“没有使用人工智能”。

sentences.en: He wanted fans to know that he'd drawn 1,800 illustrations for the project.
sentences.zh: 他想让粉丝知道他为这个项目绘制了 1,800 张插图。

blocks.html_en: Broader public opinion is shifting, and creators feel it.

sentences.en: Broader public opinion is shifting, and creators feel it.
sentences.zh: 更广泛的公众舆论正在发生变化，创作者也感受到了这一点。

blocks.html_en: The influencer marketing agency Billion Dollar Boy found that the share of consumers who viewed generative AI as a "negative disruptor" increased from 18% in 2023 to 32% in 2025. Those who saw it as a "positive disruptor" declined from 34% to 31%. The firm surveyed 4,000 consumers ages 16 or older in the UK and the US.

sentences.en: The influencer marketing agency Billion Dollar Boy found that the share of consumers who viewed generative AI as a "negative disruptor" increased from 18% in 2023 to 32% in 2025.
sentences.zh: 有影响力的营销机构 Billion Dollar Boy 发现，将生成式人工智能视为“负面颠覆者”的消费者比例从 2023 年的 18% 增加到 2025 年的 32%。

sentences.en: Those who saw it as a "positive disruptor" declined from 34% to 31%.
sentences.zh: 那些将其视为“积极颠覆者”的人从 34% 下降到 31%。

sentences.en: The firm surveyed 4,000 consumers ages 16 or older in the UK and the US.
sentences.zh: 该公司对英国和美国 4,000 名 16 岁或以上的消费者进行了调查。

blocks.html_en: "Part of this backlash is every platform is filled with slop," said Max Spero, CEO of AI detection startup Pangram. "It feels like the algorithms are shoving it in your face. It feels like it's harder and harder to find things made with craft by real people." Pangram recently partnered with Substack on an integration that detects whether — and how much — AI was used in writing newsletters and comments.

sentences.en: "Part of this backlash is every platform is filled with slop," said Max Spero, CEO of AI detection startup Pangram.
sentences.zh: 人工智能检测初创公司 Pangram 的首席执行官马克斯·斯佩罗 (Max Spero) 表示：“这种强烈反对的部分原因是每个平台都充满了废话。”

sentences.en: "It feels like the algorithms are shoving it in your face.
sentences.zh: “感觉就像算法把它推到你脸上一样。

sentences.en: It feels like it's harder and harder to find things made with craft by real people."
sentences.zh: 感觉越来越难找到由真人手工制作的东西了。”

sentences.en: Pangram recently partnered with Substack on an integration that detects whether — and how much — AI was used in writing newsletters and comments.
sentences.zh: Pangram 最近与 Substack 合作进行了一项集成，该集成可以检测人工智能在撰写时事通讯和评论时是否以及使用了多少。

blocks.html_en: Concerns about "AI slop" have become a focus on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, which all have automated AI detection tools that help identify content that is either entirely AI-generated or substantially edited with AI.

sentences.en: Concerns about "AI slop" have become a focus on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, which all have automated AI detection tools that help identify content that is either entirely AI-generated or substantially edited with AI.
sentences.zh: 对“AI slop”的担忧已成为 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube 等平台的焦点，这些平台都拥有自动 AI 检测工具，可以帮助识别完全由 AI 生成或大量使用 AI 编辑的内容。

blocks.html_en: Lawmakers have also gotten in the mix. The European Union and New York state recently developed laws requiring brands to inform viewers when AI-generated characters appear in ads.

sentences.en: Lawmakers have also gotten in the mix.
sentences.zh: 立法者也参与其中。

sentences.en: The European Union and New York state recently developed laws requiring brands to inform viewers when AI-generated characters appear in ads.
sentences.zh: 欧盟和纽约州最近制定了法律，要求品牌在人工智能生成的角色出现在广告中时通知观众。

blocks.html_en: AI labels aren't foolproof

sentences.en: AI labels aren't foolproof
sentences.zh: 人工智能标签并非万无一失

blocks.html_en: As platforms have rushed to ramp up their AI labeling, creators like McGrady say they have become the victims of false positives.

sentences.en: As platforms have rushed to ramp up their AI labeling, creators like McGrady say they have become the victims of false positives.
sentences.zh: 随着平台纷纷加大人工智能标签力度，麦迪等创作者表示，他们已成为误报的受害者。

blocks.html_en: Lindsey Lee Lugrin, a content creator and model, recently posted some paintings she had made by hand. However, her Instagram posts included a label that said they were "likely created or modified with AI."

sentences.en: Lindsey Lee Lugrin, a content creator and model, recently posted some paintings she had made by hand.
sentences.zh: 内容创作者兼模特 Lindsey Lee Lugrin 最近发布了一些她手工制作的画作。

sentences.en: However, her Instagram posts included a label that said they were "likely created or modified with AI."
sentences.zh: 然而，她的 Instagram 帖子包含一个标签，称这些帖子“可能是用人工智能创建或修改的”。

blocks.html_en: In some instances, using popular editing tools like Canva or Adobe's Lightroom resulted in content on Instagram, Threads, and TikTok being flagged as potentially AI-generated.

sentences.en: In some instances, using popular editing tools like Canva or Adobe's Lightroom resulted in content on Instagram, Threads, and TikTok being flagged as potentially AI-generated.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，使用 Canva 或 Adob​​e Lightroom 等流行编辑工具会导致 Instagram、Threads 和 TikTok 上的内容被标记为可能由人工智能生成。

sentences.en: Lindsey Lee Lugrin, a content creator and model, shared paintings she had made herself — by hand.
sentences.zh: 内容创作者兼模特 Lindsey Lee Lugrin 分享了她自己亲手制作的画作。

sentences.en: Meta added a label that said it was "likely created or modified with AI."
sentences.zh: Meta 添加了一个标签，称它“可能是用人工智能创建或修改的”。

sentences.en: Screenshot/Instagram/BI
sentences.zh: 截图/Instagram/BI

blocks.html_en: While third-party platforms like Pangram can assist with AI identification, none are completely accurate. (Substack added options in its AI detection feature for creators to dispute a Pangram assessment, explain how and why they used AI, and even disable the tool altogether.)

sentences.en: While third-party platforms like Pangram can assist with AI identification, none are completely accurate.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Pangram 等第三方平台可以协助人工智能识别，但没有一个平台是完全准确的。

sentences.en: (Substack added options in its AI detection feature for creators to dispute a Pangram assessment, explain how and why they used AI, and even disable the tool altogether.)
sentences.zh: （Substack 在其 AI 检测功能中添加了选项，供创作者对 Pangram 评估提出异议，解释他们如何以及为何使用 AI，甚至完全禁用该工具。）

blocks.html_en: Slip-ups can be a risk for both creators and brands.

sentences.en: Slip-ups can be a risk for both creators and brands.
sentences.zh: 失误对于创作者和品牌来说都可能是一种风险。

blocks.html_en: McGrady said that if a post made in partnership with a brand was flagged as AI, it could "harm your relationship with the brand."

sentences.en: McGrady said that if a post made in partnership with a brand was flagged as AI, it could "harm your relationship with the brand."
sentences.zh: 麦迪表示，如果与某个品牌合作发布的帖子被标记为人工智能，可能会“损害你与该品牌的关系”。

blocks.html_en: Advertisers are well aware of the public backlash an AI-heavy ad can bring.

sentences.en: Advertisers are well aware of the public backlash an AI-heavy ad can bring.
sentences.zh: 广告商很清楚人工智能广告可能会引起公众的强烈反对。

blocks.html_en: Brands are taking proactive action to prevent this. Five creators and talent managers said there had been an increase in clauses in partnership briefs and contracts that explicitly state that creators cannot use AI in parts of the content process — particularly in scriptwriting, captions, and visual edits.

sentences.en: Brands are taking proactive action to prevent this.
sentences.zh: 品牌正在采取积极行动来防止这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Five creators and talent managers said there had been an increase in clauses in partnership briefs and contracts that explicitly state that creators cannot use AI in parts of the content process — particularly in scriptwriting, captions, and visual edits.
sentences.zh: 五位创作者和人才经理表示，合作伙伴简介和合同中的条款有所增加，明确规定创作者不能在部分内容流程中使用人工智能，特别是在剧本编写、字幕和视觉编辑方面。

blocks.html_en: "If you're a brand, you obviously don't want to see an influencer you hire have a 100% negative comment section," said Jack Appleby, a relatively AI-positive creator and social media strategist. "If you're not an AI brand, you probably avoid AI right now, just because there's no reason to risk it."

sentences.en: "If you're a brand, you obviously don't want to see an influencer you hire have a 100% negative comment section," said Jack Appleby, a relatively AI-positive creator and social media strategist.
sentences.zh: “如果你是一个品牌，你显然不希望看到你雇佣的有影响力的人有 100% 的负面评论部分，”相对积极的人工智能创作者和社交媒体策略师 Jack Appleby 说。

sentences.en: "If you're not an AI brand, you probably avoid AI right now, just because there's no reason to risk it."
sentences.zh: “如果你不是人工智能品牌，你现在可能会避免人工智能，只是因为没有理由冒险。”

blocks.html_en: There is no escaping the AI era

sentences.en: There is no escaping the AI era
sentences.zh: AI时代是无法逃避的

blocks.html_en: Despite the blowback, AI pervades many aspects of content creation.

sentences.en: Despite the blowback, AI pervades many aspects of content creation.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在反弹，人工智能仍渗透到内容创作的许多方面。

blocks.html_en: Photo and video editing apps use it, whether loudly or under the hood. If you use Instagram's fancy font tools when making a Story post, it will trigger a tag that says the text has been "restyled with AI."

sentences.en: Photo and video editing apps use it, whether loudly or under the hood.
sentences.zh: 照片和视频编辑应用程序使用它，无论是大声还是在幕后。

sentences.en: If you use Instagram's fancy font tools when making a Story post, it will trigger a tag that says the text has been "restyled with AI."
sentences.zh: 如果您在制作 Story 帖子时使用 Instagram 的精美字体工具，它将触发一个标签，显示文本已“通过 AI 重新设计”。

blocks.html_en: "It's really difficult to have a fully AI-free experience right now, no matter what line of work you're in," Calveiro said. "I think a lot more people are using it than they want to admit."

sentences.en: "It's really difficult to have a fully AI-free experience right now, no matter what line of work you're in," Calveiro said.
sentences.zh: “无论你从事什么工作，现在都很难获得完全没有人工智能的体验，”卡尔维罗说。

sentences.en: "I think a lot more people are using it than they want to admit."
sentences.zh: “我认为使用它的人比他们愿意承认的要多得多。”

blocks.html_en: There are real benefits to some tools, too.

sentences.en: There are real benefits to some tools, too.
sentences.zh: 一些工具也有真正的好处。

blocks.html_en: "I very frequently tell my audience that there are ethical and moral reasons to use AI. When I do, it's from an accessibility perspective," McGrady said. "But I am a person who proudly says that I do not use generative AI."

sentences.en: "I very frequently tell my audience that there are ethical and moral reasons to use AI.
sentences.zh: “我经常告诉我的听众，使用人工智能是有伦理和道德原因的。

sentences.en: When I do, it's from an accessibility perspective," McGrady said.
sentences.zh: 当我这样做时，是从可访问性的角度出发，”麦迪说。

sentences.en: "But I am a person who proudly says that I do not use generative AI."
sentences.zh: “但我是一个自豪地说我不使用生成式人工智能的人。”

blocks.html_en: The backlash against creators' use of AI may ease in the coming months as AI-powered creative tools become ubiquitous. Labeling efforts could shift toward flagging only fully AI-generated posts.

sentences.en: The backlash against creators' use of AI may ease in the coming months as AI-powered creative tools become ubiquitous.
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能驱动的创意工具变得无处不在，对创作者使用人工智能的强烈反对可能会在未来几个月内缓解。

sentences.en: Labeling efforts could shift toward flagging only fully AI-generated posts.
sentences.zh: 标记工作可能会转向仅标记完全由人工智能生成的帖子。

blocks.html_en: More transparency about how AI is used could reduce headaches for creators and platforms alike, making room for them to explore how the tech can expand their creativity.

sentences.en: More transparency about how AI is used could reduce headaches for creators and platforms alike, making room for them to explore how the tech can expand their creativity.
sentences.zh: 关于人工智能如何使用的更多透明度可以减少创作者和平台等的头痛，为他们探索技术如何扩展他们的创造力创造空间。

blocks.html_en: "I'm very honest about how I use AI," Appleby said. "I don't really run from it. If a piece of content entertains or educates or provides value to somebody, for the most part, they shouldn't really care."

sentences.en: "I'm very honest about how I use AI," Appleby said.
sentences.zh: “我对如何使用人工智能非常诚实，”艾普尔比说。

sentences.en: "I don't really run from it.
sentences.zh: “我并没有真正逃避它。

sentences.en: If a piece of content entertains or educates or provides value to somebody, for the most part, they shouldn't really care."
sentences.zh: 如果某项内容能够娱乐、教育或为某人提供价值，那么在大多数情况下，他们不应该真正关心。”

阿什顿·麦格雷迪 (Ashton McGrady) 震惊地发现 TikTok 在她为残障骄傲月发布的帖子上贴上了“人工智能生成”的标签。

创作者花了几个小时制作一幅图像、贴纸和建议的拼贴画。

“这对我来说真的很刺耳，因为这不是我个人所认同的，我的观众也是如此，”麦迪告诉《商业内幕》。 “成为创造者的全部意义就是创造我自己。” 该帖子后来被删除了人工智能注释，且没有任何解释。

麦迪的上传内容是 TikTok 表示使用人工标记和自动化工具标记的数十亿内容之一。 麦迪表示，她在 Meta 旗下 Instagram 上的另一篇帖子中也有过类似的经历。

七位创作者表示，TikTok 和 Instagram 等平台表示，人工智能标签为观看者提供了更高的透明度，但不精确的流程导致了错误分类。 一些平台承认，它们在识别人工智能方面并不总是准确，并使用 Meta 的“可能是用人工智能创建或修改的”这样的短语来对冲。 对于创作者来说，即使是他们发布人工智能内容的建议也会损害他们的声誉。

经常在 Instagram 上发布照片的格雷戈里·利特利 (Gregory Littlely) 表示，他的几条帖子（其中包括实物宝丽来照片的扫描）表示“这篇帖子中的内容可能已被人工智能修改过”。

“当我看到这个标签时，我感到畏缩，”利特利说。 “当我知道这不是真的时，我更加畏缩。”

在人工智能强烈反对的时代，这些标签可能会对创作者产生真正的影响。 这对于价值 120 亿美元的美国网红营销行业尤其重要，在这个行业中，真实性和人际关系至关重要。 人工智能的小问题可能会让观众反对有影响力的人。 例如，YouTube 用户汉克·格林 (Hank Green) 最近因使用 ChatGPT 帮助研究脚本而受到批评，并为此道歉。

“这实际上是红字，”创作者 Lissette Calveiro 在谈到人工智能标签和对制作人工智能辅助作品的指控时说道。 一些品牌已经开始在活动简报中添加创作者不能使用生成人工智能的规定。

最近几周，人工智能已成为创作者对话的中心。 Substack 的首席执行官在推出新的人工智能检测合作伙伴关系时，对人工智能生成的 LinkedIn 帖子进行了尝试。 几天后，LinkedIn 宣布推出一个按钮来标记可疑的“AI 污点”。 YouTube 一直在撤下托管“低质量”人工智能内容的频道，Snapchat 已将完全由人工智能生成的视频设为不符合在其短视频源 Spotlight 中推荐的资格。

在创作者经济圈中，公开使用人工智能和推广人工智能公司都越来越被视为风险。 这种担忧是有道理的。 参加最近由 OpenAI 主办的豪华静修会的影响者立即遭到网上强烈反对。

人才公司 UnderCurrent Management 的首席执行官埃里克·博加德 (Eric Bogard) 表示：“人工智能存在公关问题，因为它涉及到数据中心周围的人们的工作和环境问题。” “因此，创作者对于推广人工智能公司犹豫不决。”

与此同时，2026 年，作为一个有影响力的人，在内容创作方面并没有真正的纯粹之路。 几乎每个平台都会自动使用或推送人工智能工具，从 Adob​​e Photoshop 到 TikTok 的 CapCut。 在许多方面，人工智能工具帮助创作者平衡管理社交媒体帐户和品牌交易以及集思广益的工作量。

OpenAI 等公司希望创作者对人工智能的使用更加开放。

OpenAI 今年从 Meta 挖来的查尔斯·波奇 (Charles Porch) 负责领导创意合作伙伴关系，他最近告诉 Business Insider，他的部分工作是让创作者“公开”使用人工智能。

OpenAI 发言人表示：“创作者是否选择公开分享他们如何使用人工智能完全取决于他们自己。”

人工智能的“公关问题”

人工智能正在渗透现代生活的许多方面——内容创作也不例外。

Adobe 与 Harris Poll 合作对 16,000 名创作者进行了 5 月份的一项调查，结果发现，在使用或尝试过创意 AI 的创作者中，75% 的人将其描述为“对于他们的工作方式而言，AI 是集成的或必不可少的”。

不过，并非所有创作者都愿意公开承认这一点，以免他们将人工智能“红字”戴在胸前。

YouTube 创作者 Bil​​ly Yue（又名 8illy）并没有回避人工智能。 他甚至在11月份为Anthropic的Claude制作了宣传视频。 尽管如此，这位经常在视频中加入手绘动画的创作者，在他最近上传的 YouTube 视频末尾补充道，制作中“没有使用人工智能”。 他想让粉丝知道他为这个项目绘制了 1,800 张插图。

更广泛的公众舆论正在发生变化，创作者也感受到了这一点。

有影响力的营销机构 Billion Dollar Boy 发现，将生成式人工智能视为“负面颠覆者”的消费者比例从 2023 年的 18% 增加到 2025 年的 32%。 那些将其视为“积极颠覆者”的人从 34% 下降到 31%。 该公司对英国和美国 4,000 名 16 岁或以上的消费者进行了调查。

人工智能检测初创公司 Pangram 的首席执行官马克斯·斯佩罗 (Max Spero) 表示：“这种强烈反对的部分原因是每个平台都充满了废话。” “感觉就像算法把它推到你脸上一样。 感觉越来越难找到由真人手工制作的东西了。” Pangram 最近与 Substack 合作进行了一项集成，该集成可以检测人工智能在撰写时事通讯和评论时是否以及使用了多少。

对“AI slop”的担忧已成为 TikTok、Instagram 和 YouTube 等平台的焦点，这些平台都拥有自动 AI 检测工具，可以帮助识别完全由 AI 生成或大量使用 AI 编辑的内容。

立法者也参与其中。 欧盟和纽约州最近制定了法律，要求品牌在人工智能生成的角色出现在广告中时通知观众。

人工智能标签并非万无一失

随着平台纷纷加大人工智能标签力度，麦迪等创作者表示，他们已成为误报的受害者。

内容创作者兼模特 Lindsey Lee Lugrin 最近发布了一些她手工制作的画作。 然而，她的 Instagram 帖子包含一个标签，称这些帖子“可能是用人工智能创建或修改的”。

在某些情况下，使用 Canva 或 Adob​​e Lightroom 等流行编辑工具会导致 Instagram、Threads 和 TikTok 上的内容被标记为可能由人工智能生成。

虽然 Pangram 等第三方平台可以协助人工智能识别，但没有一个平台是完全准确的。 （Substack 在其 AI 检测功能中添加了选项，供创作者对 Pangram 评估提出异议，解释他们如何以及为何使用 AI，甚至完全禁用该工具。）

失误对于创作者和品牌来说都可能是一种风险。

麦迪表示，如果与某个品牌合作发布的帖子被标记为人工智能，可能会“损害你与该品牌的关系”。

广告商很清楚人工智能广告可能会引起公众的强烈反对。

品牌正在采取积极行动来防止这种情况发生。 五位创作者和人才经理表示，合作伙伴简介和合同中的条款有所增加，明确规定创作者不能在部分内容流程中使用人工智能，特别是在剧本编写、字幕和视觉编辑方面。

“如果你是一个品牌，你显然不希望看到你雇佣的有影响力的人有 100% 的负面评论部分，”相对积极的人工智能创作者和社交媒体策略师 Jack Appleby 说。 “如果你不是人工智能品牌，你现在可能会避免人工智能，只是因为没有理由冒险。”

AI时代是无法逃避的

尽管存在反弹，人工智能仍渗透到内容创作的许多方面。

照片和视频编辑应用程序使用它，无论是大声还是在幕后。 如果您在制作 Story 帖子时使用 Instagram 的精美字体工具，它将触发一个标签，显示文本已“通过 AI 重新设计”。

“无论你从事什么工作，现在都很难获得完全没有人工智能的体验，”卡尔维罗说。 “我认为使用它的人比他们愿意承认的要多得多。”

一些工具也有真正的好处。

“我经常告诉我的听众，使用人工智能是有伦理和道德原因的。 当我这样做时，是从可访问性的角度出发，”麦迪说。 “但我是一个自豪地说我不使用生成式人工智能的人。”

随着人工智能驱动的创意工具变得无处不在，对创作者使用人工智能的强烈反对可能会在未来几个月内缓解。 标记工作可能会转向仅标记完全由人工智能生成的帖子。

关于人工智能如何使用的更多透明度可以减少创作者和平台等的头痛，为他们探索技术如何扩展他们的创造力创造空间。

“我对如何使用人工智能非常诚实，”艾普尔比说。 “我并没有真正逃避它。 如果某项内容能够娱乐、教育或为某人提供价值，那么在大多数情况下，他们不应该真正关心。”
